notes:
Ordinary dialogue is no longer read as inner monologue.

The app tried to tell a thought balloon from a speech balloon by measuring how uneven its outline was. Measured on a real chapter, that number turned out to be meaningless: twenty-one plain round speech bubbles on one page scored all over the range, well past the line that means "thought". Nineteen of twenty-one lines of normal conversation were being spoken in the thought voice, and slower.

It has been removed rather than adjusted, because there was nothing there to adjust. A bubble is speech, big lettering is a shout, words on the artwork are narration. Real thought bubbles come back when the app can see an actual outline.

Comes with 2.33.0, if you skipped it: every balloon is read in the order it is printed, and shouts and laughter are no longer deleted in silence.
